hints.content: We have two tapes that are the same length. Let's start by writing an expression for the length of each tape.
The top tape has a length of $24$ units.

The bottom tape has $8$ parts, each with a length of $q$ units.

The total length of the bottom tape is $8\times q$ units, which we can simplify to $8q$ units.

So, the tape diagram shows us $24=8q$.

The section labeled $q$ is $\dfrac{1}{8}$ the length of the $24$ unit long tape.

$q=\dfrac{24}{8}={}?$
